required_acceptance_order: Fresh complete admitted repository-node and terminal inventory; preserve known and unavailable members, no shrinking to obtain PASS
Verify an exact-source-bound native universal Transputer and universal Terminal at every inventoried node under required_node_runtime; freeze package only through the mesh-contract gate.
Bind own-host principal, privileged executor, private transfer, actual persistent mount, public IPv4/HTTPS routing and valid certificate
Exact-source candidate CI succeeds; freeze and independently verify the static React plus native S1 package for each admitted node
Instantiate the hosting-platform pipeline against exact artifact and existing admit/supervisor/run-admitted operations; retain deployment run/readback

Independently GET exact static document and assets from public HTTPS for every repository-node and the Mesh; recheck hashes and deployed source identity; verify every required_repository_surface capability via fresh node-bound immutable snapshot plus independent byte-exact readback
Open every admitted universal terminal and verify its live client identity/source/replica before emission
Submit one fresh nonce-bound ping through the existing owner Unix ingress of the universal Transputer, not a substitute observer or HTTP health route
Read back that exact native event id, ledger epoch, digest, nonce and logical ping identity at every admitted terminal; verify authenticated terminal-bound receipt and actual receive times
Preserve the same event/epoch/receipt chain after deployed restart; no receipt transfer from a predecessor source

Inject every required_node_runtime fault case on the actual public workload; verify original native-effect journal, writer fences, Work Unit/session continuity, complete node coverage and workload-bound RTO/SLO.
Persist the exact finite-scope completion receipt only after all public, native and terminal checks are closed

simultaneous_receive.meaning: One shared logical ping/barrier and complete receipt set in a measured receive window

retry_condition: Existing account/identity/billing gate closed and an authenticated own-host provisioning plus privileged execution/private transfer route is available; reobserve candidate before effect. Do not retry DigitalOcean mutation without changed payment admission.
smallest_next_action: Complete the already encountered provider-native account/identity/billing handoff, then bind actual host and reuse existing S1 admit/supervisor/run-admitted. No new blanket text approval is required.

required_repository_surface.normative_scope: Every current and future admitted QIK-VRT repository node, including Authority and Personal/Mirror, plus the Mesh aggregate.
required_repository_surface.provision_rule: Each node MUST expose its own repository-bound public HTTPS evidence surface. A central dashboard link or an unbound copy does not satisfy node provision. Node paths on a shared admitted host are allowed only with independently verifiable identity, source, artifacts, storage and readback.
required_capabilities: Public node identity, repository and role, deployed exact HEAD/TREE/artifact binding and separately observed remote repository state; packaged source must never be labeled current remote main.
Fresh external HTTP observations with method, status or explicit unknown/error, observation time and measured latency; preserve unavailable known nodes.
Automatic refresh on opening/resume/reconnect and live changes through the existing replica/SSE path; explicit refresh; unchanged state is deduplicated.
Immutable persisted observation bytes and SHA-256 with an independent request that returns those exact bytes; original timestamps remain visible on failure.
Visible observation history and downloadable machine-readable evidence; declare and verify retention, and retain protected native effect receipts under their existing policy.
Exact source/package manifest, digest, licenses and downloadable runtime/bootstrap artifacts with download-byte verification; historical findings remain labeled historical.
Repository-owned or admitted hosting-CI background execution that works without an open client or this chat, with recorded run identity and fresh readback.
Visible separation of observation, persistence, deployed native runtime, universal-Transputer event, complete terminal receipt set and finite product acceptance.

freshness.rule: Event-driven delivery may be faster; verify declared freshness and retention for each node. Failed refresh must not rewrite an old observation's timestamp or imply fresh acceptance.

required_repository_surface.privacy_and_rights: Use only authorized public metadata and exportable licensed bytes. Standard nodes must not inherit Personal contents, credentials, private terminal input or native event bodies.
required_repository_surface.reuse: Extend docs/monitor/self-host.mjs, server.mjs, client-replica.js and the existing S1 package/hosting path. The Sites/D1 instance is a capability reference, not a substitute for each own-host deployment.
required_repository_surface.acceptance_rule: Every inventoried node and the Mesh aggregate require fresh, complete, exact-source-bound surface receipts and all pre-existing native first-ping/terminal/restart gates. No node removal, predecessor evidence transfer or automatic product approval.

implementation_obligations: Each Authority, Mirror and future admitted node runs its own universal Transputer and universal Terminal; a source copy, central link or reference-only profile is not live node acceptance.
Expose every necessary authorized operation through documented REST/API adapters; browser remote-proxy interaction is not an execution carrier.
Preserve logical work-unit/session identity, original causal/event order, durable effect receipts and authenticated readback across serving-node changes.
Replicate the native effect journal and confirmation before positive Effect-Ack; monitor observation replication alone does not establish native-effect replication.

Use independent failure domains, authenticated peer discovery and quorum/fencing for every write takeover. Repository role does not create a permanent single execution dependency or grant promotion authority.
A returned node remains fenced until authenticated original-byte catch-up and current epoch/admission verification. An unknown effect is readback-only until resolved.
The bus may learn from attributed verified observations under existing adaptation policy; the neuronal description is an architectural analogy, not biological or autonomous authority evidence.

acceptance_limits.slo_binding: Declare workload, topology, fault bound, independent failure domains and RTO/SLO before a live transparency claim; missing numerical limits block that claim.

required_node_runtime.acceptance_rule: Every inventoried member retains an explicit state; require fresh exact-source-bound native component and fault-injection receipts per node and for the aggregate. No inventory shrink, predecessor evidence transfer, lost confirmed effect or duplicate irreversible effect.
required_node_runtime.existing_runtime_limit: S1 exports the native single-node ledger/owner ingress/HTTP-SSE terminal and a separate monitor read-replica. General native-effect replication, fenced writer takeover and live transparent recovery across every node are NOT_ESTABLISHED.

local_repository_cache.live_acceptance_rule: Require a complete admitted work/executor inventory and independent exact-byte node idle/readback evidence before expanding the finite cache-writer scope. Measure actual workload latency/throughput, total transferred bytes, queue age and recovery; do not infer global speedup or optimal scheduling from fewer payload transfers.
local_repository_cache.native_safety: Confirmed native effects retain immediate replication/fencing/Effect-Ack obligations. Deferred work proposals never become durable cross-node effect confirmation or execution authority.
local_repository_cache.implementation_scope: Existing S1 launcher private snapshot/fsync/OS-lock primitives and existing MonitorStore/listener; no parallel scheduler, executor or native effect ledger.
